messages:
anya: Heads-up: APAC-friendly customer demo Tue 9am PT. Need owners for reg page, Zoom, backup stream, clips SLA.
mike: I can own Zoom + RTMP fallback. Will set alt-hosts.
jess: Ill take reg page + HubSpot mapping. Adding EU consent toggle.
tom: Ill own post-event pipeline: auto-split, captions, CDN upload.
anya: Zoom settings: cloud recording ON, separate files, active speaker + gallery, transcripts.
mike: toggling cloud_recording=true, record_separate_files=true, join_before_host=false, alt_hosts=jess@example.com,tom@example.com. Will also enable record during screen share.
jess: Reg page checklist: CTA copy, hidden utm fields, hs_person_id, consent checkbox. Ill drop final copy by EOD in #marketing-ops.
tom: Clips: auto-split by scene markers, metadata keys event_id/speaker/start_ts/priority. Manual owner for failed splits.
anya: Backup plan: if live fails swap to 30-min pre-record. Mike can you pre-upload mp4 and test RTMP to Zoom?
mike: yes. Test command: ffmpeg -re -i backup.mp4 -c copy -f flv rtmp://zoom.rtmp.example/live/STREAMKEY
replaybot: scheduled: auto-upload -> /replays/1749993000/demo_backup.mp4 :white_check_mark:
jess: HubSpot flow: register -> confirm email + calendar add -> add to demo-registrants -> on attended webhook tag demo-attended -> trigger clip delivery.
tom: Need speaker timestamps from transcript for highlight extraction; will run whisper-large for SRT then vendor QC for top clips.
anya: SLAs: raw recording within 15m, clips + SRT within 6 business hours, highlight email draft within 48h.
mike: I'll create Zoom preflight checklist in invite and run a dry-run tomorrow 8am PT.
jess: Ill localize confirmation copy FR/DE/ES and add GDPR language for EU IPs.
tom: CDN paths: /events/1749993000/{clip_id}.mp4 and {clip_id}.srt. Tag assets with demo-attended and speaker.
anya: Ownership recap: jess = reg + HS, mike = Zoom + fallback, tom = clips + captions. Add timezones to event doc and confirm dry-run.
mike: :thumbsup:
jess: :raised_hands:
tom: on it.
anya: Lock the page after final copy is posted.
